summary: Software Engineer with experience designing, automating, and operating production cloud infrastructure at Siemens. Built deployment platforms, Kubernetes workflows, and CI/CD automation that improved deployment speed and reliability. Currently researching LLMs for Android testing and bug reproduction as a Master's student at the University of Cincinnati.

bullets: Executed **44 production environment upgrades in 4 months** across Dockerized, **Kubernetes**-based Teamcenter X services, ensuring reliable deployments through careful planning, validation, and rollback procedures.

Migrated **40+ production environments** from process-based deployments to GitOps-driven **Kubernetes** workflows using **ArgoCD**, **Helm**, Amazon EFS, and HashiCorp Vault, modernizing deployment architecture.

Designed and implemented an Ansible-based Blue-Green deployment framework with automated rollback, **reducing production upgrade downtime by 50%** and enabling full environment recovery within **15 minutes**.
Automated **AWS infrastructure workflows** using **Python (Boto3)**, replacing legacy Ruby scripts and **reducing deployment time by 40%** across production environments.
Reduced monthly **AWS infrastructure costs by 40% (from $15K to $9K)** through EC2 rightsizing and automated cleanup of unused cloud resources using CloudWatch utilization metrics.

Built a self-service developer platform (dashboard, CLI, and YAML automation) for environment lifecycle management, **adopted by 15 engineers**, **reducing environment provisioning time by 70%** and lifecycle operations by up to **90%**.
Served as Quality Coach and SonarQube Specialist for the Agile Release Train, **increasing automated test coverage from 35% to 78%** by enforcing coding standards and CI/CD quality gates.
Automated AWS infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and optimized Ansible-based DevOps workflows, **reducing deployment time by 30%** and environment setup from hours to minutes.
Developed a Go + Terratest validation framework that **caught 95% of infrastructure misconfigurations** before production, improving deployment reliability.

bullets: Developed full-stack **React**/**MySQL** register app, digitizing record management and automating workflows.
**Improved efficiency by 40%**, deploying a system that improved transparency and accuracy across the department.

entries.title: Memory-Augmented LLM Approach for Android Bug Reproduction from Video Reports
bullets: Proposed two-stage memory-augmented LLM pipeline decoupling video understanding from device automation for Android bug reproduction.
Demonstrated **25.7x latency reduction** vs baseline ViBR across **20+ Android apps**.

entries.title: PolicyPilot - Medical Benefit Policy Intelligence Portal (Agents Assemble Hackathon)
bullets: Architected evidence-grounded **RAG** pipeline over **Google Gemini 2.5-flash**, enforcing citation-backed answers to eliminate hallucination in eligibility decisions.
Designed **17-tool MCP** server for PA extraction, readiness evaluation, and payer comparison, exposed to external AI agents.
